title: Startup Sound
description: This project adds a startup sound for all the FancyMenu Users out there with an intro without sound! However, this mod does not require fancymenu and does not interfere with it. It just has very good timing (around half a second after minecraft starts).
body: This mod loads the sound from config/fancymenu/assets/audio.wav . You do not need FancyMenu, If you don't have fancymenu, just make the folders fancymenu/assets/ in config and drop your startup sound named audio.wav in there (case sensitive as it is a file path).
